definitions: A CoroutineScope defined in the Android Architecture Components library, specifically for use within a ViewModel. It is automatically cancelled when the ViewModel is cleared, ensuring that any coroutines launched within it do not outlive the ViewModel and prevent memory leaks.
The scope tied to the lifecycle of an Android ViewModel, used for launching coroutines that need to be cancelled when the ViewModel is no longer needed.
examples: The network request was initiated within viewModelScope.
Ensure all background tasks use viewModelScope.
